l.i: ciorum ratione fraudem ijs non facerent: qua-
terni ex tribus agri partibus praetores cum
rent, remq; numariam ex commodo totius

main_text.l: regionis constituerent. Pronunciatum prid.
Petri & Pauli Apostolorum anno M. CCC.
XXXVIII[?], sed sigillis tribus tantum sig-
natum, Fivelingio, Hunesgonio, Dren-
tino; reliquis, quibus signari debuerat,
Groningano, Fredowoldio, Langowol-
dio, Hummerzio, Octopagico, non
adjectis. Unde suspicio mihi est, condi-
tiones illas duriores recusasse civitatem.
Nec tamen eâ minus pax coiit. Ab annis
deinde non multis arx[?] Selwerdia bono
Reip. à Groninganis, Hunesgoniis, Fi-
velgoniis, Langowoldiis pecuniâ publicâ
empta est, & solo aequata: pecuniaque
in hunc usum à sociis omnibus collata.
Periculosa quippe arcis ejus firmitas non
solum urbi, sed caeteris quoque de liber-
tate suâ sollicitis videbatur. Et cum pe-
cuniae ejus gratiâ controversia inter ur-
banos

page.notes: The first part of the page is set in italic, and the sentence runs over from the previous page. "irx" in "irx Selwerdia" is doubtful; it is probably "arx". The numeral "xxxviii" is printed with broken letters and is copied as read. The printed "ijs" and "Hunesgonio" are kept as printed. The catchword "banos" and signature "E 5" are at the foot. The scan has a Google watermark at the bottom right, which is left out.
